title: Design Intern
note: Year-long UK packaging design placement for current design undergraduates; the posting does not state UK right-to-work rules and may close before 31 December.

facts.duties: Explore and develop packaging concepts (structure and visuals) for the company's New Categories products, make renders and animations, and help keep the packaging experience consistent.
facts.requirements: Currently studying Industrial, Product, Packaging or Visual Design or similar; some skill in tools like Illustrator, Photoshop, Rhino, KeyShot or Figma; prior work experience not essential.
facts.apply: Apply Now button on the BAT careers page (req 81042).
